meta.name: behuman
meta.description: Use when the user wants more human-like AI responses — less robotic, less listy, more authentic. Triggers: 'behuman', 'be real', 'like a human', 'more human', 'less AI', 'talk like a person', 'mirror mode', 'stop being so AI', or when conversations are emotionally charged (grief, job loss, relationship advice, fear). NOT for technical questions, code generation, or factual lookups.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让AI回复更自然、更像真人
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI回复少些机械感、多些人情味
copy.tagline_en: Make AI responses more natural and human-like
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI replies to feel less robotic and more authentic

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先产生一个本能回答，然后自我反思（去掉客套话、列表式结构），最后输出更自然、更像真人的回应。
howto.when: 当你要求“behuman”、“be real”、“像真人一样说话”，或对话涉及情绪话题（如失业、分手、恐惧）时触发。不用于技术问题、代码生成或事实查询。

say.note: 触发情绪支持模式，Claude 会先反思再回应。

say.text: be real，帮我写一段自我介绍。
say.note: Claude 会避免模板化，写出更真实的文字。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first generates an instinctive response, then self-reflects (removing filler, lists, and empty empathy), and finally outputs a more natural, human-like reply.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'behuman', 'be real', 'like a human', etc., or when the conversation is emotionally charged (grief, job loss, fear). Not for technical questions, code, or facts.

say_en.text: behuman, I just got laid off.
say_en.note: Triggers emotional support mode with inner reflection.

say_en.text: be real, help me write a bio.
say_en.note: Claude avoids templates and writes authentically.
